{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
sales_df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Check for missing values
missing_values = sales_df.isnull().sum()

# Check unique values in relevant columns
unique_channels = sales_df['channel'].unique()
unique_segments = sales_df['customer_segment'].unique()
unique_statuses = sales_df['status'].unique()

# Check revenue column for non-numeric values
revenue_sample = sales_df['revenue'].head(10)

missing_values, unique_channels, unique_segments, unique_statuses, revenue_sample"}
